our_implementation_difference: Evaluated under frozen deep CNNs with strict patient-disjoint splits and SSIM leakage guards.
prior_work_already_answers: Partially (Cheng tested SVM; Bissoto tested skin lesions)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Addresses slice-level data leakage confounding in previous reports.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Destroys global anatomical context and image aspect ratio.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Demonstrate that frozen CNN retains non-trivial classification with intra-tumoral features alone.

our_implementation_difference: Evaluated with matched focal contralateral placebo and patient-cluster bootstrap.
prior_work_already_answers: No (Prior works lacked matched spatial placebo controls)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Decouples regional ablation from general loss of image area/pixels.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Introduces artificial high-frequency boundary step-edge artifacts (219.5 gradient).
required_evidence_for_contribution: Prove that drop exceeds matched contralateral placebo ablation with non-overlapping CIs.

our_implementation_difference: Contralateral mirror-reflected region with automated collision-shift algorithm guaranteeing 0 tumor overlap.
prior_work_already_answers: No (No prior brain MRI study implemented matched contralateral placebos)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Controls for non-specific loss of brain parenchyma and pixel area.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Contralateral hemisphere may contain asymmetrical pathology, ventricles, or midline structures.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Quantify area ratio, anatomical symmetry, and demonstrate invariance to non-tumoral focal ablation.

our_implementation_difference: Concentric 15px Euclidean dilation ring zeroed out with tumor intact.
prior_work_already_answers: Partially (Cheng showed ring features help; did not test zero-fill drop)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Tests whether deep learning exploits perilesional parenchymal infiltration.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Introduces extreme boundary discontinuity (236.7 gradient step) bordering the tumor.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Assess whether drop reflects biological margin texture or artificial boundary artifacts.

prior_medical_imaging_use: YES (Fong 2017 in vision; Rossi 2024 via diffusion)
our_implementation_difference: First use of Navier-Stokes fluid PDE inpainting strictly confined to perilesional margin (0 tumor bleed).
prior_work_already_answers: No (Prior XAI used inpainting for whole object or blur)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Decouples perilesional parenchymal reliance from boundary step-edge artifacts.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Synthesizes plausible surrounding texture; cannot restore true pathological ground truth.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Show that performance drop vanishes when boundary is smoothed without tumor modification.

our_implementation_difference: Parametric sweep across 4 discrete radii with matched contralateral placebo rings at every radius.
prior_work_already_answers: No (First parametric margin sweep in deep MRI classification)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Tests whether margin reliance scales monotonically with distance from tumor border.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Wider placebo rings ablate increasingly large fractions of normal brain cortex.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Demonstrate non-monotonic trend and explain why net effect attenuates at wider radii.

our_implementation_difference: Scaled non-tumoral brain parenchyma by 50% outside dilated tumor.
limitation_addressed_by_us: Tests whether remote context supports intra-tumoral classification.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Confounded by 47.5% drop in global slice luminance and batch-norm covariate shift.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Distinguish between global brightness attenuation and spatial layout disruption.

our_implementation_difference: Permuted 16x16 non-overlapping patches strictly outside dilated tumor, preserving 100% luminance and variance.
prior_work_already_answers: No (First application to brain MRI distant context)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Disentangles spatial topography from global brightness attenuation.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Introduces artificial tile-seam edge discontinuities (+97.9% Sobel gradient energy).
required_evidence_for_contribution: Document that failure reflects combination of spatial layout loss and tile-seam edge noise.

our_implementation_difference: Systematic measurement of boundary step gradients and Sobel energy across all interventions.
prior_work_already_answers: No (Prior medical studies rarely quantified boundary step gradients)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Prevents false claims of biological reliance when models react to artificial edges.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Sobel gradient is a surrogate for edge energy, not a full human perceptual metric.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Formally refute margin reliance by comparing zero-fill vs inpainting boundary steps.

our_implementation_difference: 3-tier evaluation: S0 (patient split), S1 (SSIM 0.80 cluster merge), S2 (SSIM 0.75 cluster merge).
prior_work_already_answers: Partially (Vangala identified leakage; we evaluate interventions on clean splits)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Eliminates near-duplicate memorization and patient-level data leakage.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Reduces effective sample size (clusters) for bootstrap resampling.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Demonstrate that intervention effect sizes remain robust across S0, S1, and S2.

our_implementation_difference: Synchronized paired patient-cluster bootstrap (B=2,000) resampling same clusters across all 14 conditions.
prior_work_already_answers: No (Prior studies used naive slice bootstrap or standard t-tests)
limitation_addressed_by_us: Accounts for patient clustering while preserving paired sample covariance.
new_confound_introduced_by_us: Computationally intensive; requires cluster-level confusion matrix aggregation.
required_evidence_for_contribution: Report bootstrap distributions, 95% CIs, and McNemar transition counts.
